name: Unspent Reserves
text: Have your maximum Commodity value as Commodities.

name: Brave Extinction
text: Have less than 4 infantry on the game board in total

name: Light Military
text: Have more than 8 non-fighter ships on the game board, while also having no Dreadnaughts, War Suns, or Flagships on the game board.

name: Typecast
text: Have more than half of your planets be the same trait (Hazardous, Cultural, or Industrial)
notes: This does count home planets as typeless, and is thus harder for factions with multiple home planets.

name: Participation Trophy
text: Score no public objective, and have no other secret objectives unscored in your hand.
notes: A player scoring this cannot opt into scoring a public objective AFTER scoring this during the status phase. Only public objectives scored during the status phase count.
automationNotes: The bot checks that you scored no public objective in this status phase and hold no other unscored secret. If you score this first, do not score a public objective afterwards; the bot does not stop you.

name: Relinquish Technology
text: Lose control of a planet with an attachment
automationNotes: When you lose control of a planet with an attachment, the bot offers a Score button. Losses the bot does not see (manual unit or planet edits) need /so score.

name: Options
text: Have 7 or more action cards in your hand.

name: Planned Obsolescence
text: Lose control of a planet with a structure
notes: Any player's structure counts, including one that was on the planet at the end of the combat in which you lost it.
automationNotes: When you lose control of a planet, the bot offers a Score button and says whether it still sees a structure there. If the structure was already removed, confirm yourself that it held one.

name: Reclusive Nature
text: Have ships in no system aside from your home system and adjacent systems.
notes: Having no ships on the game board at all also qualifies.

name: Nothing to lose
text: Have zero action cards, trade goods, and unexhausted planets in your play area. (May be scored after your public objective)
notes: If a public objective requires spending any of the following, and you qualify AFTER spending, then this is valid, but only if reaching zero in ALL of these.

name: Preparation for War
text: Have a total of 8 tokens in your fleet, strategy and tactics pools.

name: Unnecessary Predictions
text: Have 3 or more Strategy tokens unused on your sheet.

name: Policy Indifference
text: End an agenda phase where you did not play any before/after agenda action cards or cast any votes with all your planets unexhausted.
automationNotes: At the end of the agenda phase the bot offers a Score button if you cast no votes and all your planets are ready. Check yourself that you played no before/after agenda action cards.

name: Policy Defiance
text: During the agenda phase, be the only player to vote for either For or Against
automationNotes: When a For/Against agenda resolves, the bot offers a Score button to a player who was the only one voting on one side. Votes added outside the vote buttons are not seen. In Fog of War games there is no prompt, so votes stay hidden; score it with the normal secret objective buttons.

name: Long-distance Relations
text: Have an Alliance card of a player whose home system is more than 5 hexes away.

name: Word of Mouth
text: Have a Support for the Throne card of a player whose home system is more than 5 hexes away.

name: Paying Respects
text: Have ships in a system adjacent to an eliminated player's home system.

name: New worlds
text: Control 2 planets that are both more than 5 hexes away from your home system.

name: A Grand Entrance
text: Win a space combat with your flagship in a system more than 5 hexes away from where your flagship was located at the start of this action.
automationNotes: When a space combat ends during your turn with your flagship still there, the bot offers a Score button if the flagship started your turn more than 5 hexes away (or if it could not tell where it started). Mutual destruction and retreats are not detected; confirm the win yourself.

name: Observing the Possibilities
text: Have units in 4 systems containing different wormhole types.

name: Reprimanded
text: Lose a space combat in a system adjacent to Mecatol Rex, or Mecatol Rex itself.
automationNotes: When your last ship in a system at or next to Mecatol Rex is destroyed while another player still has ships there, the bot offers a Score button. Retreats are not detected; confirm the loss yourself.

name: Under Our Supervision
text: Have another player gain a victory point via Imperial with ships in an adjacent system to either Mecatol Rex, or that player's Home system.
notes: Only the Mecatol Rex victory point from Imperial counts, not public objectives scored with Imperial.
automationNotes: When another player scores the Imperial Mecatol Rex point, the bot offers a Score button if you have ships next to Mecatol Rex or their home system.

name: Policy Maker
text: During the agenda phase, vote more than any other player for any outcome.
automationNotes: When an agenda resolves, the bot offers a Score button to the player who cast strictly more votes than anyone else. Votes added outside the vote buttons are not seen. In Fog of War games there is no prompt, so votes stay hidden; score it with the normal secret objective buttons.

name: Distant Flags
text: Have two structures on the board more than 5 hexes away from your home system.

name: Proud Flagbearer
text: Have your flagship in a system more than 5 hexes away from your home system with no other non-fighter ships

name: Exploit Exhaustion
text: Win a ground combat against a player who had Passed.
automationNotes: When the last ground forces of a passed player on a planet are destroyed in ground combat, the bot offers the remaining player a Score button. Confirm the win yourself.

name: Quick Deliberations
text: Be the first player to Pass their turn.
